name: q1-relay-strip
description: the hand-wired relay as a long strip (240 cells, no mutation or turnover), the signals view; a touch of the signal pipette at its left end at 4 s

evals.js: const v = moire.cells.view; await moire.tissues.place('relay', {n: 240, shape: 'strip', x: v.cssW / 2, y: v.cssH / 2 + 12 * moire.cells.R}); return 'placed ' + moire.cells.R
const f = await moire.tissues.focus('relay', 1.6); moire.relayAt = f; return JSON.stringify(f)
const f = moire.relayAt; moire.signals.drop(f.x - 36 * moire.cells.R, f.y); return 'poked'
